:::{#exm-information-equality-fails}
#### When the support depends on the parameter

Let $\dsn{X} \siid \text{Uniform}(0, \param)$.
The likelihood is $\Lik(\param) = \param^{-n}$ for $\param \ge \max_i x_i$
(and 0 otherwise),
so on that range $\llik(\param) = -n \log \param$
and $\score(\param) = -n/\param$.
The score is a nonzero constant,
so $\E{\score} = -n/\param \ne 0$:
@eq-score-mean-zero fails,
because the set of possible data values, $(0, \param)$, depends on $\param$.
:::
